# Mega Themes Converge to Outperform Markets
Morgan Stanley’s four key investment themes for 2026—AI & Tech Diffusion, the Future of Energy, a Multipolar World and Societal Shifts—are beating benchmarks as their intersections accelerate market impact.

## Key Takeaways
- Stocks aligned to Morgan Stanley’s four 2026 investment themes have gained 7% for the year to date, beating both the S&P 500 and MSCI World Index.

Three months after the introduction of Morgan Stanley’s [key investment themes](https://www.morganstanley.com/insights/articles/investment-outlook-shaping-markets-2026) for 2026, stocks tied to the four core themes are outperforming the broader market.

“These gains reflect not only the strength of each theme individually, but also the growing intersections between them,” says Stephen Byrd, Morgan Stanley’s Global Head of Thematic and Sustainability Research.

### **Geopolitics Reinforces a Multipolar World**
Morgan Stanley Research analysts see upside for select defense stocks as governments around the world increase their spending on national security.
